title: Enhancing Logical Reasoning in Language Models via Symbolically-Guided Monte Carlo Process Supervision
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2025)
authors_zh: Xingwei Tan、Marco Valentino、Mahmud Elahi Akhter、Maria Liakata、Nikolaos Aletras
paper_type_zh: 符号推理 rollout、过程监督数据与筛选配方
best_for_zh: 研究 Monte Carlo 过程标签、PRM 筛选、SFT/DPO 数据构造及发布审计的读者
one_line: Releases 1,505 Symbolic ReAct trajectories with 12,448 Monte Carlo-derived step labels, plus 15,412 accepted SFT traces and 21,472 PRM-ranked DPO pairs derived from FOLIO, FOLIOv2, and LogicAsker.
该工作用答案可达性的 Monte Carlo 伪标签训练 PRM，将 Symbolic ReAct rollout 筛成 15,412 条 SFT 轨迹和 21,472 个 DPO 对；主要价值是公开了数据转换链，关键边界是步骤形式有效性与完整候选池仍不可审计。
why: It makes the offline data transformation explicit—answer-checked rollouts become step supervision, a PRM filters and scores new traces, and those scores yield SFT and preference data—while exposing the gap between answer reachability and formally valid reasoning.
inclusion_reason: This work exposes a concrete offline rollout lineage from Monte Carlo answer-reaching pseudo-labels to a PRM, accepted SFT traces, and paired DPO traces. It directly fits the rollout/search track while making sampling budget, selection thresholds, and the retained-versus-rejected boundary central audit objects.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official EMNLP 2025 paper studies a specific construction problem: how to turn sampled symbolic reasoning into process supervision without requiring human step labels or a scalable formal solver. Natural-language chains may exploit surface content, while formally checking every generated first-order-logic operation is expensive and brittle. The proposed compromise is to write each attempt as a Symbolic ReAct trajectory—variable-length Thought, Action, and Observation steps followed by a final label—and infer step labels from whether sampled continuations can still reach the known answer (Paper §§1, 3.1–3.2).

This belongs in rollout_search_test_time_trace_data because the important object is not one final answer. The construction samples 10 continuations from every intermediate prefix, learns a Process Reward Model (PRM) from the resulting labels, and uses PRM scores to keep or pair later rollouts. Three released record types expose different slices of that chain: 1,505 trajectories with 12,448 step labels (input, step list, and +/- labels), 15,412 accepted SFT rows (question_id, question, response), and 21,472 DPO rows (question_id, question, positive, negative).

The work does not supply executable symbolic proof states, an online search policy, or evidence that every retained step is formally valid. Its L4 boundary is therefore citation- and artifact-verified but reuse-partial: the raw second-stage candidate pool, rejected yield, per-step scores, PRM checkpoint and calibration, decontamination, and item-level lineage are unavailable. The Card is useful because it records both the observable data transformation and the missing evidence needed to attribute the reported gains.

EMNLP 2025 正式论文研究的是一个具体的数据构造问题：如何在不依赖人工步骤标注、也没有可扩展形式求解器的情况下，把采样得到的符号推理转化为过程监督。自然语言推理链可能利用表层内容，而逐步形式检查每个生成的一阶逻辑操作成本高且脆弱。论文采用的折中方案是把每次尝试写成 Symbolic ReAct 轨迹，即长度可变的 Thought、Action、Observation 步骤和最终标签，再根据采样后缀能否到达已知答案来推断步骤标签（论文 §§1、3.1–3.2）。

该工作属于 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data，因为关键数据对象不是单个最终答案。构造过程从每个中间前缀采样 10 个续写，用由此得到的标签训练 Process Reward Model（PRM），再用 PRM 分数保留或配对后续 rollout。三类已发布记录展示了转换链的不同切面：1,505 条轨迹及 12,448 个步骤标签（input、步骤列表与 +/- 标签）、15,412 条被接收的 SFT 记录（question_id、question、response），以及 21,472 条 DPO 记录（question_id、question、positive、negative）。

该工作没有提供可执行的符号证明状态、在线搜索策略，也没有证明每个保留步骤在形式上有效。因此，其 L4 边界是引文和 artifact 已核验，但复用仍属 partial：原始第二阶段候选池、淘汰率、逐步分数、PRM checkpoint 与校准、去污染以及样本级谱系均不可用。本 Card 的价值在于同时记录可观察的数据转换和归因实验结果所需但仍缺失的证据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a three-layer offline transformation: answer-checked Monte Carlo continuations → stepwise pseudo-labels and a PRM → selected SFT traces and score-ranked DPO pairs. A one-shot Symbolic ReAct prompt asks a model to formalize facts and rules and to expose Thought/Action/Observation operations. For each prefix, 10 completions from Llama3.3-70B-Instruct or Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct are sampled; at least one ground-truth-reaching completion produces a positive label, and zero successes produces a negative label. Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is then trained as a binary PRM.

The feedback contract is mixed. The terminal comparison is programmatic at the answer-label level, but the generated symbolic operations are not executed by a formal verifier. The PRM observes text prefixes and learned pseudo-labels; it cannot directly observe proof validity. In the second stage, it accepts an SFT trajectory only when every predicted step is positive and the final answer is correct. For DPO, the product of step-positive probabilities is a trajectory score, and two candidates form a pair only when their score gap exceeds 0.25. “Negative” in a released pair therefore means lower PRM score, not demonstrated logical invalidity.

Relative to prior offline Monte Carlo process supervision over natural-language traces, the change is the Symbolic ReAct representation and its use as the object being labeled and filtered. Relative to nearby rollout/search work such as TreeRL, the search is offline prefix completion rather than an on-policy tree supplying RL advantages; relative to A*-Thought, the verifier selects newly generated symbolic trajectories rather than compressed paths. Monte Carlo estimation, PRMs, SFT, and DPO are existing components; the distinctive object is their linked symbolic-data pipeline and its released SFT/DPO derivatives.

本文贡献是一条三层离线转换链：答案核验的 Monte Carlo 续写 → 步骤级伪标签与 PRM → 筛选后的 SFT 轨迹和按分数排序的 DPO 对。one-shot Symbolic ReAct prompt 要求模型形式化事实和规则，并显式写出 Thought、Action、Observation 操作。对每个前缀，使用 Llama3.3-70B-Instruct 或 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 采样 10 个续写；只要至少一个续写到达 ground truth 就标为正，零个成功则标为负，随后把 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 训练成二分类 PRM。

反馈契约是 mixed。终点比较在答案标签层面是 programmatic，但生成的符号操作没有交给形式 verifier 执行。PRM 观察文本前缀和学到的伪标签，不能直接观察证明有效性。第二阶段中，只有当 PRM 对所有步骤都预测为正且最终答案正确时，轨迹才进入 SFT。对 DPO，逐步正类概率的乘积作为轨迹分数，两个候选的分差超过 0.25 才组成一对。因此，发布数据中的“negative”表示 PRM 分数较低，而不是已证明逻辑无效。

与面向自然语言轨迹的既有离线 Monte Carlo 过程监督相比，本文真正改变的是 Symbolic ReAct 表示以及对这种对象进行标注和筛选。与 TreeRL 等相邻 rollout/search 工作相比，它使用离线前缀续写，而不是从 on-policy 搜索树导出 RL advantage；与 A*-Thought 相比，verifier 筛选的是新生成的符号轨迹，而不是压缩后的路径。Monte Carlo 估计、PRM、SFT 和 DPO 都是已有组件；区别性对象是它们连接而成的符号数据流水线及其发布的 SFT/DPO 衍生数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reconstructable pipeline is:

  1. Inputs. Draw random training-question subsets of 1,003 FOLIO, 1,000 FOLIOv2, and 300 LogicAsker items. The item manifest and seed are not released. A one-shot prompt specifies Symbolic ReAct formatting and first-order-logic-style operations.
  2. Seed trajectories and prefix rollouts. Llama3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct generate Symbolic ReAct trajectories. At every intermediate prefix, sample 10 completions. Assign +1 when at least one completion ends with the ground-truth label and -1 otherwise. The released repository file contains 1,505 input records with aligned step (value) and sign (label) arrays, totaling 12,448 steps (Paper §3.2, §4, Appendix A).
  3. PRM. Fine-tune Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with a binary classification head on those hard labels. The paper reports 10 epochs, batch size 8, learning rate \(5\times10^{-7}\), maximum sequence length 2,048, adamw_torch_fused, and development-accuracy checkpoint selection. The PRM checkpoint and calibration results are not released.
  4. Second-stage generation. Llama3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct generate symbolic candidate trajectories for all training questions. Candidate count per question, temperature, top-p, seeds, and model allocation for the reported run are unknown. Monte Carlo labeling consumed about 250 AMD MI300X GPU-hours; later sampling took about 42 hours (Appendix A).
  5. Selection and outputs. SFT retains only trajectories with all PRM step probabilities above 0.5 and a ground-truth-matching final answer, yielding 15,412 released rows. DPO multiplies step-positive probabilities to score each trajectory and pairs a higher and lower candidate when the score difference exceeds 0.25, yielding 21,472 released pairs. The product is not length-normalized in the reported contract.
  6. Training and evaluation. The retained responses support full SFT; preference pairs support DPO. Evaluation covers FOLIO, the paper’s 900-example LogicAsker subset split evenly into train/development/test, and three claim-verification datasets. The two Hugging Face derivatives expose only a train split, and no decontamination procedure is reported.

End-to-end reproduction requires a pinned repair beyond fixing model versions. generate_intermediate_react.py and generate_trajectory_samples_vllm.py reference undefined args.data_path and a nonexistent prompts/LogiAsker_react_example.txt spelling; dpo_training.py references undefined args.model_name. Repository defaults of 5 samples, temperature 1.0, and Qwen3-32B are not the paper’s 10-completion 70B/72B PRM-labeling setting. A reproducer must therefore freeze the paper configuration, disclose the missing second-stage decoding settings, repair these entry points, and record raw candidates, scores, source IDs, and software versions.

可重建的流水线如下：

  1. 输入。 从训练问题中随机抽取 1,003 条 FOLIO、1,000 条 FOLIOv2 和 300 条 LogicAsker。样本 manifest 与随机种子未发布。one-shot prompt 规定 Symbolic ReAct 格式和一阶逻辑式操作。
  2. 种子轨迹与前缀 rollout。 Llama3.3-70B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 生成 Symbolic ReAct 轨迹。对每个中间前缀采样 10 个续写；至少一个续写以 ground truth 标签结束时记为 +1，否则记为 -1。仓库发布文件包含 1,505 条 input 记录，步骤数组 value 与符号数组 label 对齐，总计 12,448 个步骤（论文 §3.2、§4、Appendix A）。
  3. PRM。 在这些硬标签上微调带二分类头的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。论文报告的设置为 10 个 epoch、batch size 8、学习率 \(5\times10^{-7}\)、最大序列长度 2,048、adamw_torch_fused，并按开发集准确率选择 checkpoint。PRM checkpoint 和校准结果未发布。
  4. 第二阶段生成。 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 为全部训练问题生成符号候选轨迹。论文实验中的每题候选数、temperature、top-p、随机种子及模型分配未知。Monte Carlo 标注约消耗 250 个 AMD MI300X GPU-hour，后续采样约耗时 42 小时（Appendix A）。
  5. 筛选与输出。 SFT 只保留全部步骤 PRM 概率高于 0.5 且最终答案匹配 ground truth 的轨迹，发布 15,412 条记录。DPO 将逐步正类概率相乘作为整条轨迹的分数，当高低候选分差超过 0.25 时组成一对，发布 21,472 对。论文契约中的乘积未做长度归一化。
  6. 训练与评测。 被保留的 response 用于 full SFT，偏好对用于 DPO。评测覆盖 FOLIO、论文构造的 900 条 LogicAsker 子集（train/development/test 各 300 条），以及三个 claim verification 数据集。两个 Hugging Face 衍生数据都只提供 train split，论文未报告去污染流程。

端到端复现不仅需要固定模型版本，还需要修复代码。generate_intermediate_react.py 和 generate_trajectory_samples_vllm.py 引用了未定义的 args.data_path，并指向不存在的 prompts/LogiAsker_react_example.txt 拼写；dpo_training.py 引用了未定义的 args.model_name。仓库默认的 5 次采样、temperature 1.0 和 Qwen3-32B 也不是论文使用的 10 次续写、70B/72B PRM 标注设置。因此，复现者必须冻结论文配置，补充第二阶段缺失的 decoding 参数，修复这些入口，并记录原始候选、分数、source ID 和软件版本。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence is conditional rather than a blanket data-quality result.

  • Released-object checks. The pinned repository JSON contains 1,505 trajectories and 12,448 aligned step labels. Direct counting gives 10,709 positive and 1,739 negative labels; 1,164 trajectories are all-positive and 341 contain at least one negative label. The official Hugging Face APIs expose one train split with 15,412 SFT rows and one train split with 21,472 DPO rows. These checks establish release size and schema, not semantic correctness.
  • In-domain fine-tuning. In Table 1, Qwen Symbolic Trajectory-FT reports 68.14 accuracy on FOLIO and 74.00 on LogicAsker; the Llama counterpart reports 63.24 and 63.67. The conditions use the paper’s generated symbolic trajectories and full fine-tuning. Benchmark gains do not by themselves validate every trace or the PRM labels.
  • PRM filtering ablation. Appendix B, Table 5 reports Llama at 62.25/63.00 without PRM filtering versus 63.24/63.67 with it on FOLIO/LogicAsker, and Qwen at 65.20/73.33 versus 68.14/74.00. This is evidence for task-specific filtering benefit, with a small LogicAsker difference for Qwen; it is not evidence of formal step validity.
  • Negative result for pair construction. Section 6.1 reports that SFT generally outperforms DPO and suggests that cumulative PRM probabilities may not distinguish trajectories adequately. This matters because the released DPO “negative” is only relatively lower-scored under a product of learned probabilities.
  • Out-of-domain behavior. Table 2 reports Qwen SFT at 81.93 on Vitamin C, 58.07 on Climate-FEVER, and 60.40 on PHEMEPlus; Llama SFT reports 86.06, 78.27, and 72.00. Transfer is not uniform: Llama SFT is below process-DPO on PHEMEPlus (72.00 versus 73.47).

All performance numbers are author-reported and have not been independently reproduced for this Card. The artifact inspection verifies counts, fields, links, and script behavior; it does not upgrade the paper’s model results into proof of data quality.

最有力的证据具有明确条件，不能概括为整体数据质量结论。

  • 发布对象核查。 固定 commit 的仓库 JSON 包含 1,505 条轨迹和 12,448 个对齐步骤标签。直接计数得到 10,709 个正标签和 1,739 个负标签；1,164 条轨迹全部为正，341 条至少含一个负标签。官方 Hugging Face API 显示一个含 15,412 条 SFT 记录的 train split 和一个含 21,472 条 DPO 记录的 train split。这些核查确认发布规模与 schema，不确认语义正确性。
  • 域内微调。 Table 1 中，Qwen Symbolic Trajectory-FT 在 FOLIO 和 LogicAsker 上分别报告 68.14 和 74.00 的准确率；对应 Llama 结果为 63.24 和 63.67。实验条件使用论文生成的符号轨迹和 full fine-tuning。benchmark 提升本身不能验证每条轨迹或每个 PRM 标签。
  • PRM 筛选消融。 Appendix B 的 Table 5 报告：Llama 在无 PRM 筛选时为 62.25/63.00，加入筛选后为 63.24/63.67；Qwen 则从 65.20/73.33 变为 68.14/74.00，顺序均为 FOLIO/LogicAsker。这表明筛选在特定任务上有收益，其中 Qwen 在 LogicAsker 上差异很小；它不构成步骤形式有效性的证据。
  • 偏好对构造的负面结果。 §6.1 报告 SFT 整体上优于 DPO，并推测累计 PRM 概率可能无法充分区分轨迹。这一点很重要，因为发布的 DPO “negative”只是在学习概率乘积下相对低分。
  • 域外行为。 Table 2 报告 Qwen SFT 在 Vitamin C、Climate-FEVER、PHEMEPlus 上分别为 81.93、58.07、60.40；Llama SFT 分别为 86.06、78.27、72.00。迁移并不一致：Llama SFT 在 PHEMEPlus 上低于 process-DPO（72.00 对 73.47）。

所有性能数字均为作者报告，本 Card 未做独立复现。artifact 核查验证的是数量、字段、链接和脚本行为，不会把论文的模型结果升级为数据质量证明。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baseline is offline Monte Carlo process supervision: sample continuations from a reasoning prefix, use terminal correctness as a proxy for prefix quality, and train a PRM. The paper does not originate that recipe, ReAct, PRMs, SFT, or DPO. Its concrete change is to make the trace itself symbolically structured—explicit formula construction and rule-oriented Thought/Action/Observation steps—and then carry the learned prefix signal through two downstream data products.

At the object level, the work links three supervision interfaces: hard +/- labels on steps, PRM probabilities aggregated into a trajectory score, and chosen/rejected full-trajectory pairs. At the selection level, it exposes two thresholds with different meanings: every step above 0.5 plus a correct final answer for SFT, and a trajectory score gap above 0.25 for DPO. At the release level, it publishes the labeled seed file and exact SFT/DPO derivatives, but not the raw candidate pool or score vectors. The novelty is therefore a symbolic representation plus an integrated data-transformation recipe, not a new formal verifier.

For rollout/search data research, this distinction is useful because it lets curators ask whether gains come from the representation, the 10-completion budget, the 70B/72B completers, the learned PRM, the filter, or the optimizer. The current release cannot fully separate those factors. Before reusing the approach, a study should retain every candidate and completion, normalize or calibrate trajectory scores, log per-source lineage, and compare against equal-budget natural-language and formal-execution baselines.

最接近的 baseline 是离线 Monte Carlo 过程监督：从推理前缀采样续写，用终点正确性代理前缀质量，再训练 PRM。论文并非首次提出这一配方，也没有首创 ReAct、PRM、SFT 或 DPO。它真正改变的是轨迹本身的结构：显式构造公式并用面向规则的 Thought、Action、Observation 步骤表示推理，随后把学到的前缀信号传递到两种下游数据产品中。

在数据对象层面，本文连接了三类监督接口：附着在步骤上的硬 +/- 标签、聚合为轨迹分数的 PRM 概率，以及 chosen/rejected 整轨迹对。在筛选层面，它公开了含义不同的两个阈值：SFT 要求每个步骤高于 0.5 且最终答案正确；DPO 要求轨迹分差超过 0.25。在发布层面，它提供带标签的种子文件和确切的 SFT/DPO 衍生数据，但不提供原始候选池或分数向量。因此，其新意是符号表示与一体化数据转换配方，而不是新的形式 verifier。

对 rollout/search 数据研究而言，这一区分有助于追问提升究竟来自表示、10 次续写预算、70B/72B completer、学习得到的 PRM、筛选器，还是 optimizer。当前发布无法完全分离这些因素。复用前应保留全部候选和续写，对轨迹分数做归一化或校准，记录逐来源谱系，并与等预算的自然语言 baseline 和形式执行 baseline 比较。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The paper’s own central limitation is that Monte Carlo pseudo-labels cannot guarantee step correctness. A positive step means that at least one sampled completer recovered the answer, so an invalid prefix may receive a false positive through correction, guessing, or shortcut use. A valid but difficult prefix may receive a false negative when all 10 completers fail. The 70B/72B completers reduce but do not eliminate this model-relative error, and no formal execution audit or PRM confusion analysis is reported.

The learned selector adds further risk. Multiplying uncalibrated positive-step probabilities makes the score sensitive to trajectory length and to one low-probability step. A 0.25 pair gap is therefore not a logical margin, and the paper’s weaker DPO results are consistent with insufficient score differentiation. Curator inference: selecting only all-positive, answer-correct SFT traces can hide useful recoveries and systematic failure modes, while a DPO lower-scored trajectory may still be valid.

Release completeness blocks full audit. The SFT data omit all discarded candidates and their yield; the DPO data omit candidates never paired, raw probability vectors, and trajectory scores. The step-label file has no source item ID, generator/version field, completion outputs, or success count. The PRM checkpoint, calibration, exact second-stage sample count and decoding settings, DPO beta, software environment, and immutable lineage manifests are unavailable. No decontamination or benchmark-overlap analysis is reported, and compatibility between the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 derivative cards and upstream FOLIO/FOLIOv2/LogicAsker terms is not established.

The checked repository is also not an executable record of the reported experiment: two generation scripts use undefined args.data_path and a misspelled LogicAsker prompt filename, while the DPO entry point uses undefined args.model_name. Script defaults also differ from the reported PRM-labeling setup. Finally, evaluation concentrates on logic and three claim-verification datasets; reported benchmark performance is not evidence that the verifier generalizes to other reasoning domains or that the released data are uncontaminated.

论文明确承认的核心限制是 Monte Carlo 伪标签不能保证步骤正确。正标签只表示至少一个采样 completer 找回了答案，因此无效前缀可能通过后续纠错、猜测或 shortcut 获得 false positive；有效但困难的前缀也可能因 10 个 completer 全部失败而得到 false negative。70B/72B completer 可以降低但不能消除这种相对于模型的误差，论文也没有报告形式执行审计或 PRM 混淆分析。

学习得到的 selector 还会引入额外风险。未校准的逐步正类概率直接相乘，使分数对轨迹长度和某个低概率步骤敏感。因此，0.25 的配对差值不是逻辑 margin，论文中较弱的 DPO 结果也与分数区分不足相一致。Curator inference：只保留全部步骤为正且答案正确的 SFT 轨迹，可能隐藏有价值的恢复过程和系统性失败模式；DPO 中较低分的轨迹仍可能有效。

发布完整性使全面审计受阻。SFT 数据遗漏所有被丢弃候选及其产出率；DPO 数据遗漏未进入任何 pair 的候选、原始概率向量和轨迹分数。步骤标签文件没有 source item ID、生成器/版本字段、completion 输出或成功次数。PRM checkpoint、校准、第二阶段精确采样数和 decoding 设置、DPO beta、软件环境以及不可变谱系 manifest 均不可用。论文没有报告去污染或 benchmark overlap 分析，也没有说明采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 的衍生数据卡与上游 FOLIO/FOLIOv2/LogicAsker 条款是否兼容。

核查的仓库也不是可直接执行的论文实验记录：两个生成脚本使用未定义的 args.data_path 和拼写错误的 LogicAsker prompt 文件名，DPO 入口使用未定义的 args.model_name；脚本默认值还与论文报告的 PRM 标注设置不同。最后，评测集中于逻辑任务和三个 claim verification 数据集；benchmark 表现不能证明 verifier 能泛化到其他推理领域，也不能证明发布数据没有污染。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For this track, the Card is a concrete template for logging search-generated training data: record the prefix, completion budget, completer models, terminal predicate, hard label, PRM probability, aggregation rule, acceptance threshold, rejected candidates, and compute. It supports controlled comparisons of answer-reachability labels against formal step verification, of all-positive rejection sampling against softer filters, and of product scores against calibrated or length-normalized trajectory values.

The released step labels can seed PRM/process-supervision experiments, and the SFT and DPO releases can support non-commercial research under their stated CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 metadata. Reuse is nevertheless conditional: verify upstream source terms, reconstruct item lineage, perform contamination checks, and repair/pin the code before training. The artifacts should not be used as an evaluation set because they expose train-only derivatives of benchmark training questions.

The safest present reuse class is research and audit reference with conditional training reuse, not a turnkey end-to-end recipe. It is especially useful for ablations that retain the raw candidate pool and failed continuations, because the official release does not. It is not evidence-backed as RLVR, online RL, or test-time inference data; the supported uses are PRM/reward modeling, process supervision, SFT, and DPO preference learning.

对本 track 而言，该 Card 是记录搜索生成训练数据的一份具体模板：应保存前缀、completion 预算、completer 模型、terminal predicate、硬标签、PRM 概率、聚合规则、接收阈值、被拒候选以及计算成本。它可支持以下受控比较：答案可达标签与形式步骤验证、全正 rejection sampling 与较软筛选、概率乘积与经校准或长度归一化的轨迹价值。

已发布步骤标签可用于 PRM/过程监督实验，SFT 和 DPO 数据可在其 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 元数据所允许的非商业研究范围内使用。不过，复用仍有条件：训练前需要核验上游来源条款、重建样本谱系、执行污染检查，并修复及固定代码版本。这些 artifact 不应作为评测集，因为它们是由 benchmark 训练问题形成、且只提供 train split 的衍生数据。

当前最安全的复用等级是研究与审计参考，可在满足条件后训练复用，而不是开箱即用的端到端配方。它尤其适合在自行保留原始候选池和失败续写的前提下做消融，因为官方发布没有这些对象。没有证据支持把它用作 RLVR、online RL 或测试时推理数据；有证据的用途仅限 PRM/reward modeling、过程监督、SFT 和 DPO preference learning。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §§3.1–3.2 and Appendix C first: Symbolic ReAct is structured text with Thought/Action/Observation steps, not an executable proof trace.
  • Keep the three object counts separate: 1,505 trajectories / 12,448 step labels, 15,412 accepted SFT rows, and 21,472 relative DPO pairs.
  • Interpret the label contract literally: one success among 10 continuations means answer reachability, not formal prefix correctness.
  • Use Table 1 with Appendix B, Table 5: filtering helps in the reported tasks, but SFT generally beats DPO and the Qwen LogicAsker filtering gain is small.
  • Read alongside TreeRL and A*-Thought to compare offline prefix completion, on-policy tree rewards, and validator-guided path selection; compare equal budgets and release boundaries.
  • Before reuse, verify the upstream licenses and decontamination, obtain or retrain/calibrate the PRM, repair the checked-in scripts, and retain raw candidates plus score vectors.

• 优先阅读 §§3.1–3.2 和 Appendix C：Symbolic ReAct 是带 Thought/Action/Observation 步骤的结构化文本，不是可执行证明轨迹。
  • 分开记住三组对象数量：1,505 条轨迹 / 12,448 个步骤标签、15,412 条被接收的 SFT 记录，以及 21,472 个相对 DPO 对。
  • 按字面理解标签契约：10 个续写中有 1 个成功表示答案可达，不表示前缀在形式上正确。
  • 将 Table 1 与 Appendix B 的 Table 5 一起读：筛选在报告任务上有帮助，但 SFT 整体优于 DPO，且 Qwen 在 LogicAsker 上的筛选收益很小。
  • 与 TreeRL 和 A*-Thought 对读，比较离线前缀续写、on-policy 树奖励和 verifier 引导的路径选择；同时控制预算并比较发布边界。
  • 复用前应核验上游许可和去污染，获取或重训并校准 PRM，修复仓库脚本，并保留原始候选和分数向量。
